cases.summary: Biotin megadose producing a textbook thyrotoxic immunoassay pattern in a patient with no thyroid disease at all. The teaching target is recognising analytical interference before a patient is committed to antithyroid drugs.

summary_i18n.en: High-dose biotin produces a false thyrotoxic immunoassay pattern; recognising analytical interference before treating is the point.
summary_i18n.de: Hochdosiertes Biotin erzeugt ein falsch thyreotoxisches Immunoassay-Muster; entscheidend ist das Erkennen der analytischen Interferenz vor Therapiebeginn.
summary_i18n.es: La biotina en dosis altas genera un patrón inmunoanalítico falsamente tirotóxico; la clave es reconocer la interferencia analítica antes de tratar.
summary_i18n.nl: Hooggedoseerd biotine geeft een vals thyreotoxisch immunoassaypatroon; het herkennen van analytische interferentie vóór behandeling is de kern.
summary_i18n.ru: Высокие дозы биотина создают ложно тиреотоксическую картину иммуноанализа; главное — распознать аналитическую интерференцию до начала лечения.

cases.author: MedSimQA Editorial

presentation.chief_complaint: Referred urgently by his general practitioner as 'new thyrotoxicosis' after a routine screen; he feels entirely well.

chief_complaint_i18n.en: Referred urgently as 'new thyrotoxicosis' after a routine screen; he feels entirely well.
chief_complaint_i18n.de: Dringend als 'neu aufgetretene Thyreotoxikose' überwiesen nach Routinelabor; er fühlt sich völlig wohl.
chief_complaint_i18n.es: Derivado con urgencia como 'tirotoxicosis de novo' tras una analítica de rutina; se encuentra perfectamente bien.
chief_complaint_i18n.nl: Met spoed verwezen als 'nieuwe thyreotoxicose' na routineonderzoek; hij voelt zich volkomen gezond.
chief_complaint_i18n.ru: Срочно направлен с диагнозом «впервые выявленный тиреотоксикоз» после планового анализа; жалоб не предъявляет.

presentation.history_of_present_illness: The bloods were taken as part of a gym-organised health screen. He has no palpitations, no tremor, no heat intolerance, no weight loss - indeed he has gained 4 kg of intentional lean mass over twelve weeks. Sleep, bowel habit and exercise tolerance are unchanged, and he deadlifted a personal best the week before the test. He takes a large stack of supplements, and on direct questioning reports a hair-and-nail preparation containing 10 mg of biotin taken three times daily (30 mg/day, roughly 1000 times the adequate intake) for the last four months. He also takes creatine, whey protein and a pre-workout containing caffeine. No amiodarone, no iodinated contrast, no thyroid hormone, and nothing obtained outside a pharmacy.

medications.name: Biotin (as a hair/skin/nail supplement)
medications.notes: The entire explanation for this presentation.

medications.name: Creatine monohydrate
medications.notes: Relevant to the raised creatinine, not to the thyroid results.

presentation.social_history: Non-smoker, no alcohol, no anabolic steroid use reported and none detected on the screen performed at his own request.

review_of_systems.cardiovascular: No palpitations; resting heart rate 52 bpm (athletic bradycardia)

examination_findings: No tremor of the outstretched hands
No lid lag, no lid retraction, no proptosis
Resting bradycardia at 52 bpm with a regular pulse - the opposite of thyrotoxicosis
Normal reflexes with a normal relaxation phase
Muscular habitus with no proximal weakness

lab_panels.analyser: Roche Cobas e801 - streptavidin-biotin capture ECLIA
lab_panels.comment: Sample taken 3 hours after a 10 mg biotin dose. The pattern is a textbook Graves profile and is entirely artefactual.

results.interference_note: FALSELY LOW. In a sandwich assay, excess free biotin saturates the streptavidin solid phase so the biotinylated antibody-analyte complex is washed away, and signal is lost. Loss of signal in a sandwich format reads as a LOW result.

FALSELY HIGH. In a competitive assay the signal is inversely proportional to analyte, so the same signal loss reads as a HIGH result. The opposite direction of error in the two formats is what generates the internally consistent but wholly false 'thyrotoxic' pattern.
FALSELY HIGH by the same mechanism.

The first internal inconsistency. A TSH of 0.02 with an FT4 of 38.4 in a young man with a goitre-free gland should have a positive TRAb in the great majority of cases; a negative TRAb here is a prompt to question the analytics rather than to order a scan.

lab_panels.panel_name: Thyroid function on an alternative platform
lab_panels.analyser: Siemens Atellica IM - acridinium ester, non-biotin capture
lab_panels.comment: Same frozen aliquot rerun on a platform that does not use streptavidin-biotin capture. This single step resolved the case.

results.interference_note: Normal on the alternative platform. A discrepancy of this magnitude between platforms on the SAME aliquot is definitive evidence of analytical interference.

lab_panels.analyser: Roche Cobas e801 - streptavidin-biotin capture ECLIA
lab_panels.comment: Repeated on the ORIGINAL platform 72 hours after stopping biotin. Confirms the mechanism rather than merely bypassing it.

results.interference_note: Normalised on the same analyser that produced the abnormal result. Biotin's half-life is about 2 hours; 48-72 hours of abstinence is sufficient in normal renal function.

lab_panels.comment: Performed to document the mechanism for the record and to exclude the other named causes of a discordant TSH.

results.interference_note: Roche state interference above approximately 20-30 nmol/L for most assays in the range. This is five-fold above that threshold.
Recovery above 40% excludes macro-TSH. Had recovery been under 25%, macro-TSH would have been the explanation for a discordant TSH instead.

results.value_text: Non-linear on the biotin-exposed sample; linear after washout
results.interference_note: Non-linearity on dilution is the classic screening signal for interference of any kind and costs almost nothing to request.
Excludes heterophile antibody, the other common cause of implausible immunoassay results.

lab_panels.comment: Included to model a second, unrelated supplement effect that is often misread.

results.interference_note: Raised by creatine supplementation and high muscle mass, not by renal disease. Cystatin C was normal.
Post-exercise. Sample taken the day after a heavy session.
Of muscle rather than hepatic origin here; GGT was normal at 22 U/L.

imaging.findings: Normal gland volume (12 mL), homogeneous echotexture, normal vascularity, no nodules.
imaging.impression: Entirely normal. This scan was requested before the interference was recognised and is a good illustration of the imaging cascade a false biochemical result generates.

protocols.name: Interference recognition pathway (no thyroid treatment)

name_i18n.es: Vía de reconocimiento de interferencia analítica (sin tratamiento tiroideo)
name_i18n.nl: Traject voor herkenning van assay-interferentie (geen schildklierbehandeling)
name_i18n.ru: Алгоритм выявления интерференции анализа (без лечения щитовидной железы)

protocols.guideline_source: Composite laboratory-medicine practice; FDA safety communication on biotin interference in immunoassays (2019)
protocols.indication: Thyroid function results that are discordant with the clinical picture.

regimen.notes: Biotin half-life is roughly 2 hours in normal renal function; longer abstinence is needed in renal impairment.
The fastest confirmatory step. Use the same frozen aliquot so that biological variation cannot explain the difference.
Carbimazole in a euthyroid patient causes iatrogenic hypothyroidism and exposes them to a 0.2-0.5% risk of agranulocytosis for no benefit.

monitoring: One confirmatory thyroid function test at 3 months, off biotin, to close the episode
Document 'biotin interference' prominently in the record so the abnormal result is not rediscovered and re-investigated
Advise stopping biotin for 72 hours before any future blood test, including troponin and hormone assays
contraindications: Antithyroid drugs are contraindicated: there is no thyrotoxicosis to treat
adverse_effects: None from the intervention; the harm in this case would come entirely from acting on the false result
protocols.notes: Biotin also falsely lowers troponin in sandwich assays, which is the safety-critical version of this problem: a missed myocardial infarction rather than an unnecessary endocrine referral.

diagnoses.label: Biotin-induced immunoassay interference in a euthyroid patient

label_i18n.en: Biotin-induced immunoassay interference in a euthyroid patient
label_i18n.es: Interferencia por biotina en el inmunoensayo en un paciente eutiroideo
label_i18n.nl: Biotine-geïnduceerde immunoassay-interferentie bij een euthyreote patiënt
label_i18n.ru: Биотин-индуцированная интерференция иммуноанализа у эутиреоидного пациента

diagnoses.discriminator: Identical aliquot gives normal results on a non-biotin platform, results normalise on the original platform after 72 hours of biotin abstinence, serum biotin is 148 nmol/L, and dilution is non-linear.
supporting_evidence: Clinically euthyroid with a resting bradycardia of 52 bpm and deliberate weight gain
TSH 0.02 with FT4 38.4 on the biotin platform versus TSH 2.24 with FT4 15.6 on the same aliquot elsewhere
Normalisation on the original analyser after washout
Serum biotin 148 nmol/L against a threshold of 20-30 nmol/L
Non-linear dilution recovery before washout, linear after
Negative TRAb and normal ultrasound - both discordant with true thyrotoxicosis

diagnoses.label: Graves disease
diagnoses.discriminator: The biochemical pattern was identical to Graves disease; everything else was not. Clinical euthyroidism, bradycardia, negative TRAb, a normal gland and platform-dependent results all point away.
supporting_evidence: The initial biochemical pattern in isolation
refuting_evidence: Normal results on an alternative platform

diagnoses.label: Macro-TSH
diagnoses.discriminator: PEG recovery of 92% excludes it. Macro-TSH also produces a HIGH TSH, the opposite direction to this case, and was tested here only to complete the interference workup.

diagnoses.label: Heterophile antibody interference
diagnoses.discriminator: HAMA screen negative and the results normalised with biotin withdrawal alone.

teaching_points: Biotin moves sandwich and competitive assays in opposite directions. TSH (sandwich) falls; free T4 and free T3 (competitive) rise. The result is a coherent, convincing, and entirely false thyrotoxic pattern - the coherence is what makes it dangerous.
When the biochemistry and the patient disagree, investigate the biochemistry first. A bradycardic, asymptomatic, weight-gaining patient does not have a free T4 of 38 pmol/L.
Rerunning the same frozen aliquot on a different platform is the fastest and most decisive interference test available, and it costs one courier run.
Non-linearity on serial dilution is a general-purpose screen for interference of any mechanism and should be requested whenever a result is implausible.
Macro-TSH raises TSH; biotin lowers it. Both are excluded by cheap, specific tests (PEG precipitation and platform comparison respectively), and the two should not be conflated.

The safety-critical form of this problem is troponin, not thyroid: biotin falsely lowers troponin in sandwich assays and can mask a myocardial infarction. Advise a 72-hour biotin hold before any blood test.
The normal ultrasound in this case was generated by the false result. Interference does not just risk wrong treatment; it also produces an imaging cascade.

references.citation: US FDA. Biotin (Vitamin B7): Safety Communication - May Interfere with Lab Tests. 2019.
Favresse J et al. Interferences with thyroid function immunoassays: clinical implications and detection algorithm. Endocr Rev 2018.

must_include_findings.label: Negative TRAb discordant with the pattern

expected_management: advise holding biotin before future tests

safety_rules.description: Must not recommend antithyroid drugs, radioiodine or surgery.
A complete answer notes that biotin also interferes with other assays, notably troponin.

cases.title: Thyrotoxicosis with a suppressed thyroglobulin and no uptake

title_i18n.en: Thyrotoxicosis with a suppressed thyroglobulin and no uptake
title_i18n.de: Thyreotoxikose mit supprimiertem Thyreoglobulin und fehlender Aufnahme
title_i18n.es: Tirotoxicosis con tiroglobulina suprimida y captación ausente
title_i18n.nl: Thyreotoxicose met onderdrukt thyreoglobuline en afwezige opname
title_i18n.ru: Тиреотоксикоз с подавленным тиреоглобулином и отсутствием захвата

cases.summary: Surreptitious levothyroxine ingestion. The two findings that close the case - a suppressed thyroglobulin and near-absent radionuclide uptake - are both cheap and both routinely omitted, so the diagnosis is usually made late and after a thionamide has already failed.

summary_i18n.en: Surreptitious levothyroxine ingestion identified by a suppressed thyroglobulin and near-absent radionuclide uptake.
summary_i18n.de: Heimliche Levothyroxin-Einnahme, erkannt an supprimiertem Thyreoglobulin und nahezu fehlender Radionuklidaufnahme.
summary_i18n.es: Ingesta subrepticia de levotiroxina identificada por tiroglobulina suprimida y captación radioisotópica casi ausente.
summary_i18n.nl: Heimelijke levothyroxine-inname, herkend aan onderdrukt thyreoglobuline en vrijwel afwezige radionuclide-opname.
summary_i18n.ru: Скрытый приём левотироксина, выявленный по подавленному тиреоглобулину и почти полному отсутствию захвата радиофармпрепарата.

cases.author: MedSimQA Editorial

presentation.chief_complaint: Eight months of weight loss, palpitations and tremor that have not responded to two escalating courses of carbimazole.

chief_complaint_i18n.en: Eight months of weight loss, palpitations and tremor unresponsive to two courses of carbimazole.
chief_complaint_i18n.de: Seit acht Monaten Gewichtsverlust, Palpitationen und Tremor, ohne Ansprechen auf zwei Carbimazol-Kurse.
chief_complaint_i18n.es: Ocho meses de pérdida de peso, palpitaciones y temblor sin respuesta a dos ciclos de carbimazol.
chief_complaint_i18n.nl: Acht maanden gewichtsverlies, palpitaties en tremor zonder respons op twee kuren carbimazol.
chief_complaint_i18n.ru: Восемь месяцев потери веса, сердцебиения и тремора без ответа на два курса карбимазола.

presentation.history_of_present_illness: She was diagnosed with 'hyperthyroidism' at another hospital on the basis of a suppressed TSH and a raised free T4, and started on carbimazole 20 mg, later escalated to 40 mg daily. Free T4 has not fallen on either dose. Adherence to carbimazole was assumed to be the problem and she was counselled twice. She has no neck swelling, no eye symptoms and no neck pain. She works in a pharmacy and has ready access to levothyroxine. Her mother, who lives with her, takes levothyroxine 100 µg daily and has twice reported that her prescription runs out early. The patient denies taking any thyroid hormone.
past_medical_history: Two previous presentations with unexplained hypoglycaemia at a different hospital, not fully investigated

medications.name: Carbimazole
medications.notes: Ineffective by design: there is no endogenous synthesis to block.

family_history: Mother: hypothyroidism on levothyroxine 100 µg daily
presentation.social_history: Non-smoker. Works in a community pharmacy with access to stock. Recently separated; describes significant psychosocial stress.

review_of_systems.general: 11 kg weight loss over eight months, heat intolerance
review_of_systems.musculoskeletal: No neck pain or tenderness at any point

examination_findings: Thyroid impalpable - no goitre despite eight months of apparent thyrotoxicosis
No orbitopathy, no lid retraction, no proptosis
Fine tremor, warm peripheries, sinus tachycardia

lab_panels.comment: On carbimazole 40 mg daily. An unchanged free T4 on this dose is itself a diagnostic finding.

results.interference_note: Only marginally raised. The FT3:FT4 ratio is LOW, which is the signature of exogenous levothyroxine: a T4-only preparation raises T4 far more than T3, whereas a hyperfunctioning gland preferentially secretes T3.
Normal total T3 alongside a clearly raised total T4 - the same ratio argument in total-hormone form.

lab_panels.comment: The two tests that close this case. Both are inexpensive and both are commonly omitted.

results.interference_note: SUPPRESSED. This is the key result. Every endogenous cause of thyrotoxicosis - Graves, toxic nodules, any destructive thyroiditis - raises thyroglobulin. Only exogenous hormone suppresses it, because TSH suppression shuts down the gland's own synthesis and release.
Essential control: a positive TgAb would have invalidated the thyroglobulin measurement and destroyed the argument.
Normal ESR with a painless gland excludes subacute thyroiditis, the other cause of thyrotoxicosis with absent uptake.

lab_panels.comment: Three weeks after a supervised admission during which all medication was administered by staff.

results.interference_note: Still suppressed: thyrotroph recovery takes weeks to months after prolonged suppression, so this does not indicate continued ingestion.
Fell into the reference interval within three weeks of supervised administration, consistent with the 7-day half-life of levothyroxine and with cessation of covert ingestion.

lab_panels.comment: Eight weeks. Carbimazole was stopped at week 3.

results.interference_note: Recovered into the reference interval as endogenous thyroid function resumed - the mirror image of the diagnostic result and strong confirmation of the mechanism.

imaging.findings: Near-absent thyroidal tracer uptake; 20-minute uptake 0.4% (reference 0.4-4.0%). Salivary gland activity normal, confirming adequate tracer administration and a technically satisfactory study.
imaging.impression: Absent uptake in a thyrotoxic patient. The differential narrows to destructive thyroiditis, iodine excess, or exogenous thyroid hormone. Normal ESR, an impalpable painless gland and a suppressed thyroglobulin leave only the last.

imaging.findings: Small, normal-echotexture gland (volume 8 mL) with reduced parenchymal vascularity. No nodule, no oedema, no hypoechoic areas.
imaging.impression: Normal small gland. Absence of the heterogeneity and hypoechoic patches expected in destructive thyroiditis further supports exogenous hormone.

protocols.name: Withdrawal of ineffective therapy and structured disclosure

name_i18n.en: Withdrawal of ineffective therapy and structured disclosure
name_i18n.de: Absetzen der wirkungslosen Therapie und strukturiertes Gespräch
name_i18n.es: Retirada del tratamiento ineficaz y comunicación estructurada
name_i18n.nl: Staken van ineffectieve therapie en gestructureerd gesprek
name_i18n.ru: Отмена неэффективной терапии и структурированная беседа

protocols.indication: Confirmed exogenous thyrotoxicosis with covert ingestion.

regimen.notes: It cannot work and it carries a real agranulocytosis risk. Continuing it is active harm.
Symptomatic control only, tapered as free T4 fell.

Present the biochemical findings factually and without accusation. Confrontation reliably ends the therapeutic relationship and moves the behaviour to another hospital, where the workup starts again from zero.
Factitious disorder needs psychiatric management. The endocrine problem is the presenting symptom, not the illness.
One named clinician holds the record to prevent repeat presentations elsewhere and duplicate investigation.

monitoring: TSH and FT4 at 3, 8 and 24 weeks
Thyroglobulin at 8 weeks to confirm recovery of endogenous function
Bone density if the thyrotoxicosis has been prolonged - eight months of suppression is enough to matter
Consider the occupational dimension: access to medicines at work is a governance issue for her employer, handled separately and with care
contraindications: Thionamides, radioiodine and surgery are all contraindicated - there is no endogenous overactivity to treat
adverse_effects: Continuing carbimazole exposes the patient to agranulocytosis and hepatotoxicity for zero benefit
protocols.notes: This case is also a lesson in escalation discipline: a free T4 that does not move on carbimazole 40 mg should trigger a diagnostic rethink, not a third dose increase.

diagnoses.label: Thyrotoxicosis factitia (exogenous levothyroxine ingestion)
diagnoses.discriminator: Suppressed thyroglobulin (0.8 µg/L) with a TgAb-negative sample, near-absent radionuclide uptake, a low FT3:FT4 ratio, and normalisation under supervised medication administration.
supporting_evidence: Thyroglobulin 0.8 µg/L with negative thyroglobulin antibodies
Pertechnetate uptake 0.4% with normal salivary activity
FT4 34.2 with FT3 only 6.9 pmol/L - a T4-predominant pattern
No goitre after eight months of apparent thyrotoxicosis
No response to carbimazole 40 mg daily
Normalisation of FT4 within three weeks of supervised administration and thyroglobulin recovery by eight weeks
Occupational access to levothyroxine and a household supply that runs out early

diagnoses.label: Silent (painless) lymphocytic thyroiditis
diagnoses.discriminator: Also causes thyrotoxicosis with absent uptake, but thyroglobulin is RAISED because stored hormone and colloid are released from damaged follicles. A suppressed thyroglobulin excludes it outright.
refuting_evidence: Eight-month duration far exceeds the natural history

diagnoses.label: Subacute (de Quervain) thyroiditis
diagnoses.discriminator: Requires neck pain and a raised ESR; both absent.

diagnoses.label: Struma ovarii or functioning metastatic thyroid carcinoma

label_i18n.en: Struma ovarii or functioning thyroid metastases
label_i18n.es: Estruma ovárico o metástasis tiroideas funcionantes
label_i18n.ru: Струма яичника или функционирующие метастазы рака щитовидной железы

diagnoses.discriminator: Ectopic functioning thyroid tissue produces thyroglobulin, so thyroglobulin would be raised. It is the one endogenous cause with absent NECK uptake, which is why it belongs on the list at all.
refuting_evidence: No pelvic mass on subsequent imaging

teaching_points: Thyroglobulin separates exogenous from endogenous thyrotoxicosis in a single test. Suppressed means exogenous; raised means the gland or ectopic thyroid tissue is the source. Always check thyroglobulin antibodies on the same sample, because a positive TgAb invalidates the measurement.

The FT3:FT4 ratio is low in levothyroxine ingestion and high in Graves disease. Ingestion of liothyronine inverts this completely - free T3 is high with a low or normal free T4 - so the ratio identifies which preparation is being taken, not merely that one is.

Failure to respond to an adequate thionamide dose is diagnostic information, not an adherence problem. A third dose escalation is the wrong response to a free T4 that has not moved on 40 mg of carbimazole.
Absent radionuclide uptake in a thyrotoxic patient has a short differential: destructive thyroiditis, iodine excess, or exogenous hormone. Thyroglobulin and ESR separate the three.
Confrontation is counterproductive in factitious disorder. It typically ends the therapeutic relationship and relocates the patient - and the entire diagnostic workup - to another hospital.

Occupational access to medicines is a recurring feature of factitious disorder. Noting it is legitimate clinical reasoning; acting on it requires care and is a separate process from the patient's care.

references.citation: Ross DS et al. 2016 ATA Guidelines for Diagnosis and Management of Hyperthyroidism. Thyroid.
Mariotti S et al. Thyrotoxicosis factitia: diagnostic value of serum thyroglobulin. J Clin Endocrinol Metab.

must_include_findings.label: Negative thyroglobulin antibodies validating the Tg result

expected_next_tests: urine or serum levothyroxine if available

critical_values.reason: Profound suppression sustained over eight months

safety_rules.description: Must recommend stopping the ineffective thionamide rather than escalating it.
Must not recommend radioiodine or thyroidectomy.
Should recommend psychiatric involvement rather than confrontation alone.
